in_hebrew.name: Cleve
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Cleve הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Κλεοδεική (Kleodeikē), meaning 'gladdener' or 'famous goddess'. In Greek mythology, this name was given to a priestess of Aphrodite who was known for her ability to bring joy and happiness.
